// Parabellum (Season 28)
//notes:SpaceMonkey (PvE / God-PvE): "This is very close to being very good. The only place it falls down is that attrition orbs is in the wrong column since basically SMGs are pretty only attrition orbs printers in this final update. Adaptives should at 900rpm, which is the same as the vaunted lightweight frame, so theoretically this should print orbs as fast as the more famous Yeartide Apex, but instead of a damage perk pairing like Chaos Reshaped (which is too buggy to be used anyway) or a splash perk like Incandescent it is instead paired with Heal Clip and Rewind Rounds. RR allows the gun to perform the "orb printer" functionality really well without having to pause to reload, and Heal Clip does give a small survivability boost which could be clutch for a certain kind of player. Whether this is actually going to be a good weapon for high-end content remains to be seen. It lacks a lot of the flashiness that would get this cooking in lower end content and in higher end content it is still fighting an uphill battle as an SMG but it does have its very specific niche - and of course the origin trait makes this always worth considering." Recommended MW: Reload, Range.|tags:pve,god-pve

// Parabellum (Season 28)
//notes:SpaceMonkey (PvE): "This is very close to being very good. The only place it falls down is that attrition orbs is in the wrong column since basically SMGs are pretty only attrition orbs printers in this final update. Adaptives should at 900rpm, which is the same as the vaunted lightweight frame, so theoretically this should print orbs as fast as the more famous Yeartide Apex, but instead of a damage perk pairing like Chaos Reshaped (which is too buggy to be used anyway) or a splash perk like Incandescent it is instead paired with Heal Clip and Rewind Rounds. It lacks a lot of the flashiness that would get this cooking in lower end content and in higher end content it is still fighting an uphill battle as an SMG but it does have its very specific niche - and of course the origin trait makes this always worth considering."
